resume.title: Resume
resume.name: Tahssain Amir
resume.about: I am eager to learn and develop new skills, and I enjoy sharing what I've learned with others. I am an effective communicator with experience leading both children and adults as a coach and instructor. As an instructor, I teach methodological courses in climbing gyms and outdoors on rock faces. During these sessions, I teach climbing technique and important mental preparation strategies. I also help my students overcome their fear of heights and falling. I make sure my students learn everything they need to know. As a coach, I lead training sessions for children, focusing on improving their climbing skills and preparing some of them for various climbing competitions and Slovak Cups. I'm interested in sports climbing, mountaineering, spending time in nature, and coaching and instructing. In my free time, I enjoy reading, traveling, going to the movies, and playing board and computer games.
